description: We are a team of five Computer Science students passionate about technology, space exploration and innovation. Our strengths include frontend development, UI/UX design, research and problem-solving. Our team lead has national-level hackathon experience through AeroLift BlackBox, selected for Robofest. We aim to turn ambitious ideas into impactful solutions. We welcome one more teammate skilled in backend development, Python, AI/ML or data science to strengthen our team.
